title: The road to chaos in the logistic map
hook: One parabola, one knob. Turn r up and a steady state splits into 2, 4, 8 cycles, then chaos, then a window of order.
alt: Top: a bifurcation diagram, a branching tree of dots that splits from one curve into two, four, then a dense cloud, with a vertical marker at the chosen r. Bottom: a parabola and a diagonal line with a staircase path that bounces between them.
author: @may.iterates

presets.label: r = 3.20, a 2-cycle
presets.note: The cobweb settles onto a rectangle: a 2-cycle.

presets.label: r = 4.00, coin flips
presets.note: With x = sin²(πθ) the map becomes θ ↦ 2θ mod 1, as random-looking as coin flips.

presets.label: r = 3.82, intermittency
presets.note: Just left of 3.8284 the orbit idles near a 3-cycle, then bursts away.

presets.label: r = 3.50, a 4-cycle
presets.note: Past 1 + √6 ≈ 3.449 the 2-cycle doubles: the cobweb visits four corners before it repeats.
